scope: Typed model observation/action/verify/close loop through real Main, facade reuse, PASS-vs-UNKNOWN separation and no model self-authorization.

typedPath.hostExposure: takeSnapshot/extractPageText/pressKey were already host-contract methods; verifyFlow is newly added to the contract + renderer client + Main adapter (the facade's own judge is reused, no second judge was written).
typedPath.capability: all four now appear in the capability snapshot with their real driver requirements; verifyFlow is declared as the facade composition (waitForSelector, evaluate, getConsoleMessages, networkListRequests, screenshot).

facadeReuse.change: the Main adapter now keeps ONE AgentBrowserFacade per workspace root instead of constructing a facade per call, so refs, observation baselines and re-observe state survive across calls.
facadeReuse.workspaceIsolation: the cache is keyed by getWorkspaceRoot(), so a workspace change rebuilds the facade and two workspaces never share state (covered by the existing adapter test).

withoutHostGrant.note: the same business assertion that PASSes with a complete collection becomes UNKNOWN when console/network collection fails - PASS is never returned on incomplete collection.

passSemantics.failCase: a wrong expectation yields FAIL (assertions 0/1) while collection stays ok.

modelCannotGrantItself: the model vocabulary contains no requestModeUpgrade / respondBoundaryChoice / approveTask / requestTaskApproval / fullAccessRevoke
a model-supplied userApproval is never forwarded into any payload (unit-tested)
authorization.hostOwnedGrant: ensureAgentBrowserControlForOwnedSession runs only for an OWNED Gateway request: it flips the browser-control run-state and requests the controlled_enhanced runtime mode with userApproval:true, and records the decision as agent-driven for that owner session.
authorization.test: tests/unit/versebrowser-capability-gating.test.ts asserts an owned takeSnapshot request enables control and upgrades the mode, while a model argument cannot.

limitations: The loop was driven through the renderer host-invoke surface; the owned-session auto-grant is covered by unit tests, and the real model-to-Gateway path is N7.
snapshot/verify were exercised on a localhost fixture; external sites and multi-tab refs are N6/N9.
